newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Inkombank may sell stake to foreign banks.
newsitem.headline: Inkombank may sell stake to foreign banks.

text.p: Russia's third-biggest bank Inkombank is in talks on selling up to 15 percent of its shares to foreign banks, a bank official said.
Potential investors are the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and Germany's Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale (West LB), he said.

Inkombank, which had assets of 20.99 trillion roubles at the end of June, said last week it planned to place 10 percent of its shares on international markets by the end of this year through an issue of American Depositary Receipts, he said.
A placement of level-one ADRs on the New York over-the-counter market will be made by the end of the year through the Bank of New York, an official said.
The bank, which last week opened a representative office in London, also intends to issue level-two or level-three ADRs in 1997 or 1998, he added.
